name: coin-cups
why: The coin holder's cups: a part every printability number before print_check was green on — watertight, one body, flat on its whole plate, fitting every bed — with eight retaining lips whose undersides are 0° ceilings 15 mm above the bed. Each lip's exposed underside is the 2 x 6 box clipped to the bore circle of radius 12 from x = 10.5: 8.2428 mm² by the segment integral, 65.942 mm² over eight (the mesh reads 65.80, its chords inside the bore circle), all exact planes, no bridge (each lip hangs from one wall), and a support prism to the bed through the 3 mm plate of 8 x 8.2428 x 12 = 791.31 mm³. docs/COIN_HOLDER_REVIEW.md, workflow §3 and §11.
